sources.summary: A Matti Suuronen Futuro House has been manufactured for the first time in decades and decked out by Finnish design brand Marimekko for Helsinki Design Week. The famously flying-saucer-like structure recently landed in Kaisaniemi Botanical Gardens as part of the Finnish capital's annual design festival.
